translations.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
translations.bsb: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
translations.kjv: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
translations.asv: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.
